events.summary: Avacyn emerges free from her prison when the Helvault explodes.
events.quote: Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

events.summary: Raksha's sudden departure splits the leonin into two prides, reunited by the fight to survive.
events.quote: Raksha's sudden departure split the leonin into two prides.

events.summary: Jace feigns interest in a pyromancer's mightiest attack.
events.quote: Jace feigned interest.

events.summary: Liliana insists on going to Amonkhet to confront Razaketh.
events.quote: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.

events.summary: Belzenlok transforms the ambitious Yar-Kul into a maggot.
events.quote: the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot.

events.summary: Jhoira restores the Weatherlight and a mushroom becomes her first crew member.
events.quote: As Jhoira restored the *Weatherlight*, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

events.summary: Will and Rowan receive a letter inviting them to Strixhaven.
events.quote: The letter unfolded, inviting the twins to Strixhaven.

events.summary: Tahngarth bloodies his blades on those who ravaged his home.
events.quote: Tahngarth relished the chance to bloody his blades on those who had ravaged his home.

events.summary: The Eldrazi titans' arrival on Zendikar is an apocalypse for the Zendikari and an ordinary day for the Eldrazi.
events.quote: To the Zendikari, an apocalypse. To the Eldrazi, a day like any other.

events.summary: Gideon and Liliana fight side by side despite their differences.
events.quote: Gideon and Liliana may not have seen eye to eye, but that did not stop them from fighting side by side.

events.summary: Demons of Immersturm pour into Bretagard slaughtering.
events.quote: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

events.summary: The Mirari sword slays a false god who tore the magic from Dominaria.
events.quote: Even after a false god tore the magic from Dominaria, power still radiated from the Mirari sword that slew her.

events.summary: Hanna warns Sisay to keep the Weatherlight at a safe distance from slivers.
events.quote: she urged Sisay to keep the ship at a safe distance.

events.summary: Squee is disemboweled by a beautiful sliver.
events.quote: Squee had been disemboweled many times before, but never by something so stunningly beautiful.

events.summary: Ugin explains the hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi, and Jace questions how that worked last time.
events.quote: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin.

events.summary: The Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage ravage Bala Ged.
events.quote: The continent of Bala Ged was ravaged by massive Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage, its lush jungles and cascading rivers reduced to dust.

events.summary: Ennor, cast out of Garenbrig, builds the perfect weapon for his revenge.
events.quote: Cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes, Ennor turned to fae magic to fashion the perfect weapon for his revenge.

events.summary: Urza digs into Dominaria's ancient past.
events.quote: In his hunger for power and knowledge, Urza dug deep into Dominaria's ancient past.

events.summary: Merfolk's gods are revealed as false memories of the Eldrazi titans.
events.quote: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity: the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek.

events.summary: Asha leaves Bant after ensuring protection in her absence.
events.quote: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

events.summary: Heliod's wrath destroys Olantin.
events.quote: Legend speaks of the lost coastal polis of Olantin, whose inhabitants' hubris enraged the sun god Heliod.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet dies but leaves the components for his rebirth.
events.quote: The city mourned Niv-Mizzet's death, but he left behind the components for his rebirth.

events.summary: Rorix travels to Otaria's Grand Coliseum to compete for glory.
events.quote: Rorix traveled far to compete for glory in Otaria's Grand Coliseum.
